scope: Admission rule for original-CSS Team Battle with two to four contiguous players, enforced at the CSS/SSS/match-handoff gate, the match-rules owner and the patched fn_8016DCC0 boundary. Source identified and compiled, with validator-level native unit coverage only. No browser, retail, timing, pixel, audio or performance claim.

routines.cycleTeam: advances one door through (team + 1) % 3, so a door holds team colour 0..2
routines.fn_80262F44: shows CSS Start when at least two doors are active and, with is_teams == 1, some pair of active doors has different teams; no other roster bound
routines.mnCharSel_804D6CF5: the VS CSS owns four doors
routines.gm_80169264/gm_801692BC/gm_80169290: team-dependent costume selectors for team colours 0/1/2

admitted.no_teams: free-for-all with two to four contiguous players

refused: all active players on one team
item-enabled or otherwise unsupported stock/timer rules (reported separately from the team refusal)
admission.refusal_text: Team Battle payload is outside the supported setups: two to four contiguous players, team colours 0-2, and at least two players on different teams

tests.coverage: The patched validator text is extracted from the canonical patch and compared, with the shared rule, against a literal transcription of fn_80262F44 for every team flag, roster size 0-5 and 4^4 colour assignment; named 2v2, 3v1 and 2v1v1 cases and each refusal are asserted. Reintroducing the former two-player bound into the extracted validator fails the 2v2 case.

full_suite.note: Skips are owned-asset or toolchain-dependent tests absent on the build machine; the three build/browser-dependent tests ran after the default-configuration runtime build.
